What did we see inside the house of Dularchand Yadav, who was brutally murdered in Mokama?
In this ground report, the family members share what happened that day, their pain and their demand for justice. They also explain why they are accusing Bahubali leader Anant Singh of being behind the murder.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
